MotorBrand.title: MotorBrand
MotorBrand.description: Represents a manufacturer or brand of marine motors, such as Yamaha, which is the main vendor for a motor brand module.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MotorBrand entity.

name.description: The official name of the motor brand, e.g., 'Yamaha'.

description.description: A brief description of the motor brand, including its history or specialization.

websiteUrl.description: The official website URL for the motor brand.

MotorProduct.title: MotorProduct
MotorProduct.description: Represents a specific motor product model (e.g., 'Yamaha Outboards F200') available for configuration and display.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MotorProduct entity.

motorBrandId.description: Reference to the MotorBrand this product belongs to. (Relationship: MotorBrand 1:N MotorProduct)

modelName.description: The specific model name of the motor, e.g., 'F200XSA2'.

series.description: The product series or category, e.g., 'Outboards', 'Sterndrives'.

horsepower.description: The horsepower rating of the motor.

weightLbs.description: The dry weight of the motor in pounds.

description.description: A detailed description of the motor product, highlighting its features and specifications.

basePriceUsd.description: The base price of the motor product in US Dollars, before any configurable options are applied.

imageUrl.description: URL to an image of the motor product.

ConfigurationOptionType.title: ConfigurationOptionType
ConfigurationOptionType.description: Defines a generic category for a configurable option, such as 'Shaft Length' or 'Propeller Type'.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ConfigurationOptionType entity.

name.description: The name of the configurable option type, e.g., 'Shaft Length', 'Propeller Type', 'Control System'.

description.description: A description explaining what this configuration option type represents and its purpose.

ConfigurationOptionValue.title: ConfigurationOptionValue
ConfigurationOptionValue.description: Represents a specific value or choice within a ConfigurationOptionType, along with its price impact.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ConfigurationOptionValue entity.

optionTypeId.description: Reference to the ConfigurationOptionType this value belongs to. (Relationship: ConfigurationOptionType 1:N ConfigurationOptionValue)

value.description: The actual display value for the option, e.g., '20 inches', 'Stainless Steel (3-blade)', 'Mechanical'.

description.description: A detailed description of this specific option value, including any relevant specifications or benefits.

priceImpactUsd.description: The monetary impact (positive or negative) this option value has on the motor's base price in US Dollars.

MotorProductConfigurableOption.title: MotorProductConfigurableOption
MotorProductConfigurableOption.description: Links a MotorProduct to specific ConfigurationOptionTypes and specifies which ConfigurationOptionValues are available and default for that product.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MotorProductConfigurableOption entity.

motorProductId.description: Reference to the MotorProduct this configurable option applies to. (Relationship: MotorProduct 1:N MotorProductConfigurableOption)

optionTypeId.description: Reference to the ConfigurationOptionType being configured for this product. (Relationship: ConfigurationOptionType 1:N MotorProductConfigurableOption)

availableOptionValueIds.description: An array of IDs referencing ConfigurationOptionValue entities that are available choices for this specific MotorProduct under this ConfigurationOptionType. (Relationship: ConfigurationOptionValue N:N MotorProductConfigurableOption)

defaultOptionValueId.description: Reference to the default ConfigurationOptionValue ID for this specific MotorProduct and ConfigurationOptionType. This ID must be one of the 'availableOptionValueIds'.

ConfiguredMotorInstance.title: ConfiguredMotorInstance
ConfiguredMotorInstance.description: Represents a specific motor configuration saved by a user, including the chosen options and total price, which can be used for quotes or operations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ConfiguredMotorInstance entity.

motorProductId.description: Reference to the base MotorProduct that was configured. (Relationship: MotorProduct 1:N ConfiguredMotorInstance)

name.description: A user-defined name or label for this specific configured motor instance, e.g., 'My Fishing Boat's Main Engine'.

description.description: An optional detailed description or notes about this specific motor configuration, provided by the user.

configurationDate.description: The date and time when this motor configuration was created or last updated.

configuredOptionValueIds.description: An array of IDs referencing the ConfigurationOptionValue entities that were chosen for this specific motor configuration instance. (Relationship: ConfigurationOptionValue N:N ConfiguredMotorInstance)

totalPriceUsd.description: The calculated total price in US Dollars for this specific configured motor, including the base price and all chosen option impacts.

userId.description: Reference to the user who created or last updated this configured motor instance. (Relationship: User 1:N ConfiguredMotorInstance)

params.name: motorBrandId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent motor brand.

params.name: motorProductId
params.description: The unique identifier for the motor product.

definition.description: Defines generic categories for configuration options, globally accessible for public read.

params.name: optionTypeId
params.description: The unique identifier for the configuration option type.

definition.description: Represents specific values for a configuration option type, globally accessible for public read. Includes 'optionTypeId' for direct linking and authorization independence.

params.name: optionTypeId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent configuration option type.

params.name: optionValueId
params.description: The unique identifier for the configuration option value.

definition.description: Links a specific motor product to its available configuration options. This data is publicly readable to enable client-side configuration logic. Includes 'motorProductId' and 'optionTypeId' in the document for direct linking and authorization independence.

params.name: motorBrandId
params.description: The unique identifier of the associated motor brand.

params.name: motorProductId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent motor product.

params.name: configOptionId
params.description: The unique identifier for this product-specific configurable option.

definition.description: Represents a motor configuration saved by a specific user. This collection is user-owned, meaning only the authenticated user ('request.auth.uid') can read or write their own configurations. Includes 'userId' in the path for explicit ownership and in the document for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this configured motor instance.

params.name: configuredMotorInstanceId
params.description: The unique identifier for the configured motor instance.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to cleanly separate public product catalog data from user-specific, private configuration data, ensuring robust security and simplified rule management. All product-related entities (MotorBrand, MotorProduct, ConfigurationOptionType, ConfigurationOptionValue, MotorProductConfigurableOption) are placed in top-level collections or subcollections that are globally readable. This allows any user, authenticated or not, to browse available motors and their configuration options without requiring complex authorization checks. Authorization Independence is achieved for these entities by ensuring that relevant parent IDs (e.g., 'motorBrandId' in MotorProduct, 'optionTypeId' in ConfigurationOptionValue) are either part of the document's path or denormalized into the document itself. This eliminates the need for expensive and rule-breaking `get()` operations in security rules, as all authorization context for a document is available via `request.resource.data` or `request.path`.

For user-specific data, such as a `ConfiguredMotorInstance`, a path-based ownership model is strictly enforced using `/users/{userId}/configuredMotorInstances/{configuredMotorInstanceId}`. This pattern makes authorization explicit and highly debuggable: a user (`request.auth.uid`) can only read or write to documents where the `{userId}` wildcard matches their authenticated UID. The `userId` is also denormalized within the `ConfiguredMotorInstance` document, further reinforcing ownership and enabling direct data querying based on `userId`. This directly supports QAPs (Queries as Permissions) by allowing users to securely list their own configurations via a simple query on `/users/{request.auth.uid}/configuredMotorInstances` without requiring server-side filtering.

Structural Segregation is applied by keeping the public catalog separate from private user data. This ensures that the security posture for each collection is homogeneous (e.g., all `MotorProduct` documents are publicly readable, all `ConfiguredMotorInstance` documents are user-private). This approach significantly simplifies Firestore Security Rules, making them easier to write, understand, and debug.
